scope: All candidates in docs/browser-support.md plus relevant browser/provider/bridge candidates returned by two Keep searches. Camoufox is a documentation comparison candidate, not confirmed as a saved Keep item. BrowserOS fork and upstream count as one architecture. This is not an exhaustive account export.
scoreMeaning: Author-assessed sales readiness, 0–100; 0–5 criterion grades. Scores are not success probabilities or benchmarks. Shield readiness is a separate hard eligibility gate: only the two verified local engines qualify now. Real authenticated LinkedIn behavior remains untested. Unknown performance/detectability do not earn fictional scores.

candidates.name: BrowserOS neo
candidates.route: Allman → Playwright pipe → persistent Neo → Shield gate
candidates.privacy: Local profile; Shield verified. Browser AI/provider features are outside this path.
candidates.resources: Measured: median 1,137 MiB summed process RSS
candidates.speed: Measured: median 1,434 ms protected startup; 129 ms fixture
candidates.detectability: No independent LinkedIn detection test. Shield reduces specific tracker surfaces.
candidates.benefit: Current configured default; durable login and account-isolated capture.

candidates.name: BrowserOS
candidates.route: Named executable → persistent Chromium context → required Shield checks
candidates.privacy: Local profile; protection depends on successful exact-build gate.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; full Chromium plus BrowserOS services
candidates.benefit: Agent-oriented Chromium with existing named allman adapter.
candidates.gap: Run separate restart, DNR, ownership and login checks.

candidates.name: Bundled Chromium
candidates.route: Full chromium channel → persistent profile → unpacked Shield
candidates.privacy: Local owned profile; exact Shield build verified.
candidates.resources: Measured: median 1,011 MiB summed process RSS
candidates.speed: Measured: median 1,293 ms protected startup; 108 ms fixture
candidates.detectability: Automation surfaces remain; no detection guarantee.
candidates.benefit: Portable baseline with supported extension loading and repeatable installs.
candidates.gap: Local fixture results do not prove real LinkedIn behavior.

candidates.name: Custom Chromium
candidates.route: Explicit executable or existing CDP → default context → Shield gate
candidates.privacy: Local by default; binary provenance and updates need review.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; depends on selected fork and services
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; compatibility may differ by version
candidates.benefit: Allows extension-capable Chromium forks without vendor SDK.
candidates.gap: No generic promise for every binary; never falls back silently.

candidates.name: CloakBrowser Manager
candidates.route: Manager profile with Shield → CDP → allman Node entry
candidates.privacy: Local profile; separate commercial binary trust and licensing.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; Chromium plus manager; VNC cost on Linux Docker
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; existing-profile attach may avoid cold startup
candidates.detectability: Vendor claims source-level fingerprint changes; not tested here.
candidates.benefit: Persistent profile inventory and existing CDP route.
candidates.gap: License/setup, unpacked Shield and allman live verification required.

candidates.name: Google Chrome
candidates.route: Dedicated running profile + installed Shield → CDP → allman
candidates.privacy: Local cookies; borrowed profile is never cleared or replaced.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; attach reuses process but browser still consumes RAM
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; reuse avoids launch cost, adds CDP transport
candidates.detectability: Real browser alone does not hide automation or account signals.
candidates.benefit: Familiar interactive login and mature extension management.
candidates.gap: Command-line sideloading is insufficient; install Shield in exact profile.

candidates.name: Microsoft Edge
candidates.route: Dedicated Edge profile + installed Shield → CDP → allman
candidates.privacy: Local cookies; account/session match checked before capture.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; full browser cost remains when attached
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; existing-profile attach avoids cold launch
candidates.detectability: No evidence of lower detectability than Chrome.
candidates.benefit: Same protected CDP contract in an Edge-managed environment.
candidates.gap: Installed version freshness and Shield verification need checking.

candidates.name: Viewforge · Chrome
candidates.route: Allman adapter → coordinator → one Bun worker per profile → WebView
candidates.privacy: Local journal; bearer loopback bridge; cooperative capability policy.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; one OS process per identity plus Chrome costs
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; native WebView avoids Playwright layer, no speed proof
candidates.detectability: No stealth layer is claimed by Viewforge.
candidates.benefit: Durable prospect-research workflows with typed records and resumable checkpoints.
candidates.gap: No Playwright context or exposed CDP server; prove extension loading and native API adapter.

candidates.name: Viewforge · WebKit
candidates.route: Proposed native adapter → WebKit persistent dataStore
candidates.privacy: Local persistent store; policy is not a network sandbox.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; native WebKit may differ from Chromium, no RAM claim
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; macOS backend has no local comparison
candidates.detectability: No stealth claim; WebKit identity differs from Chrome.
candidates.benefit: Native macOS automation and same durable journal model.
candidates.gap: Current Chrome MV3 Shield cannot run unchanged; macOS 15.2+ persistence requirement.

candidates.name: Obscura
candidates.route: Partial CDP server → Rust DOM/network/rendering → V8
candidates.privacy: Built-in tracker blocking differs from running Shield itself.
candidates.resources: Vendor README claims 30 MB; not measured here
candidates.speed: Vendor claims 51–84 ms page loads; incomparable to our fixture
candidates.detectability: Per-session fingerprint changes are vendor claims, not site success proof.
candidates.gap: No verified Chrome MV3, extension worker or DNR runtime; persistence semantics also need proof.

candidates.name: invisible_playwright
candidates.route: New Firefox adapter → patched binary → Firefox-compatible Shield port
candidates.privacy: Engine-level fingerprint changes; local data custody if run locally.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; README lists roughly 550 MB unpacked engine
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; package API compatibility is not latency evidence
candidates.detectability: Vendor detection-suite screenshots do not predict LinkedIn behavior.
candidates.benefit: Firefox-specific automation research with seeded engine configuration.
candidates.gap: Current allman uses Chromium CDP; README excludes CDP and lists no macOS download in quick start.

candidates.name: Camoufox
candidates.route: Firefox driver or remote Playwright → Camoufox → addon port
candidates.privacy: Local profiles; Firefox addons supported, current Shield port unproven.
candidates.resources: Vendor says debloated Firefox and ~200 MB; not measured here
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; performance depends on engine build and workload
candidates.detectability: Project discloses maintenance-gap fingerprint issues; no guarantees.
candidates.benefit: Alternative Firefox engine with addon-loading support.
candidates.gap: Need Firefox-specific Shield port, persistence tests and allman adapter.

candidates.name: ManagedCode Playwright.Stealth
candidates.route: Proposed .NET bridge → persistent Chromium → Shield + init scripts
candidates.privacy: Script patches are not network blocking; extension must remain real.
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; extra bridge and page initialization
candidates.detectability: 31 claimed patch vectors; chrome.runtime mock could conflict with verification.
candidates.benefit: Useful only if a .NET workflow already needs this library.
candidates.gap: Default one-call context pattern does not establish persistent Shield; not a browser engine.

candidates.name: Kernel CLI
candidates.route: Upload extension + durable profile → cloud browser → authenticated CDP
candidates.privacy: Cookies, page data and extension run in provider infrastructure.
candidates.resources: Local RAM falls; remote compute remains and is billable
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; network RTT and cold session time matter
candidates.detectability: Managed stealth options are vendor claims, not assurances.
candidates.benefit: Shared remote infrastructure and profile/extension APIs.
candidates.gap: Do not upload identities here: first prove extension ID discovery, CDP auth and custody requirements.

candidates.name: Donut Browser
candidates.route: Local REST/MCP → dedicated profile → CDP → allman gate
candidates.privacy: Per-profile DNS blocking; optional E2E sync changes custody.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; Chromium plus manager and optional VPN
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; local API and CDP are available
candidates.benefit: Profile, extension and optional sync management in one UI.
candidates.gap: Verify Shield unpacked install, persistent extension identity and CDP ownership.

candidates.name: OpenCLI
candidates.route: OpenCLI command → local daemon → browser extension → existing Chromium
candidates.privacy: Reuses logged-in profile; bridge and Shield are separate extensions.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; reuse avoids another browser process
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; bridge round trips versus direct automation
candidates.detectability: Existing profile does not guarantee undetectability.
candidates.benefit: Broad website command adapters; possible companion to allman.
candidates.gap: No allman context/Shield gate adapter yet; isolated app state is not isolated cookies.

candidates.name: Playwriter
candidates.route: Stateful sandbox → relay → debugger extension → selected Chrome tabs
candidates.privacy: Keeps existing profile; shared tabs require ownership discipline.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; attach can avoid duplicate browser process
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; reuses browser but relay adds work
candidates.detectability: README detection language is not independent evidence.
candidates.benefit: Full Playwright-style operations on an already logged-in browser.
candidates.gap: Adapt connection lifecycle and prove Shield verification through extension relay.

candidates.name: Agency
candidates.engine: Local work-card app + active coding agent
candidates.route: Agent prepares work → local cards → human decision → chosen tools
candidates.privacy: Loopback-only app; unauthenticated routes; agent policy is not app enforcement.
candidates.resources: Unmeasured; app and model costs depend on chosen tools
candidates.speed: Unmeasured; reasoning and approval time dominate
candidates.detectability: Inherits detectability of selected browser; no engine protection.
candidates.benefit: Sales briefs and reviewable outreach drafts around protected allman.
candidates.gap: No browser engine or Shield installation of its own; use a verified provider underneath.

candidates.name: LinkedIn Shield · security mechanics
candidates.route: Package hashes → extension origin → background + DNR + site access
candidates.privacy: Document-start interception and declarative blocking; optional user-triggered AI is separate.
candidates.speed: Blocking can avoid requests; net speed benefit not measured
candidates.detectability: Blocks specific probes; does not make accounts or browsers undetectable.
candidates.benefit: Mandatory verification before every allman browser session.
candidates.gap: No coverage for direct allman HTTP API calls; popup AI option may contact selected provider.
